cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Know the Procedure
cards.instruction: Perform investigative confidence while quietly using each response to discover what the questions, clues, and next steps should be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. As building manager, I'll establish why this door won't lock. Describe the anomaly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The hinge is loose. I usually tighten it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Precisely. Show me your usual method so I can assess it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll need the screwdriver from your desk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, we've reached the tool stage. Which drawer do you normally find it in?
